S1 — Kept activation agreement still omits a printed equipment gate and applies a branch-specific reaction to a combined operation (.6.7 S1 class remains open).
Invariant/authority: user's faithful-or-absent triage and whole-corpus instructions, owning 19.4.6/.6.6/.6.8, staged olc5.9 (printed turn cost) and olc5.10 (equipment); printed source for each operation. Kept equipment must carry the printed governing gate, and a retained action cost must govern every admitted use of the operation, rather than occur somewhere in its item description. This does not require typing DM-owned trigger/target conditions.

(a) Winged Boots fly: packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json:147467 retains the selected fly operation with its flight-minute cost and no activation.equipment. Source :147434 explicitly starts 'While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed', followed by using THE BOOTS to fly for the budgeted time. An attuned owner with the boots in inventory but unworn meets the emitted equipment contract; wearing and attunement are separate facts. The operation is an already-selected use of the boots, not a request for a new subsidiary ability. Producer magicItemUseEconomies.ts:660 supplies only the cost. Triage.ts:1170 returns operations with no draft activation / extra anchors untouched. Thus the same producer-draft-only/header omission found in .6.7 survives, now where the governing sentence grants the capability rather than saying 'you can use'. The omission screen in magicItemTriage.test.ts:668 requires HOLDING_LEAD and ACTIVATION_WORDS in the SAME sentence, so this item's clear wear gate does not enter its supposedly whole-corpus review list at all. It also has no adjudicated clause carrying that sentence.

(b) Wand of Binding assisted-escape: records.json:143902 retains activation.cost='reaction', and :143910 binds BOTH c2-residual-assisted-escape-save and c2-residual-assisted-escape-check. Printed Assisted Escape sentence says 'you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and gain advantage on a saving throw ... , or you can expend 1 charge and gain advantage on any check you make to escape a grapple'. The second alternative does not print a reaction cost. At the staged .9 boundary, selecting the grapple-check benefit nevertheless spends/requires a reaction because the composite operation has one unconditional reaction field. Producer magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:653-661 combines the two branches under that field; magicItemFaithfulOperations.ts:594-597 preserves the field while carrying both alternatives as a trigger, and triage removes the trigger while retaining the cost. The two typed EFFECT conditions already distinguish reaction-on-save from charge-on-check, but cannot narrow the independently typed operation activation. The verbatim span is present and therefore sufficient to leave an ambiguous/common-cost claim untyped; it does not justify the broader typed cost. This finding requires neither a new reaction on the check nor resolving an ambiguous continuation by inference.

S2 — Early activation-target deletion bypasses the required adjudicated governing span.
Invariant/authority: user memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent defines absence as no typed field PLUS an adjudicated-by-design clause with VERBATIM sourceText; explicit review requirement (3) says the printed governing sentence for each removed field is carried. Owning 19.4.6/.6.6 and importer-fix-protocol preserve source-backed responsibility when projections/tests are retired. A test of every EXISTING clause's substring relation does not establish that each removed predicate received a clause.

Members: magicItemFaithfulOperationsCorpus.ts:206 deletes Armor of Invulnerability activate-immunity requirement/target without any clause. :611-632 deletes drink.target for the 17-member Philter/Potion cohort, likewise without any clauses: Philter of Love; Potion of Animal Friendship, Clairvoyance, Climbing, Diminution, Flying, Gaseous Form, Giant Strength, Growth, Healing, Heroism, Invisibility, Mind Reading, Poison, Resistance, Speed, Water Breathing. Source targeting need not use the literal token 'self' to govern an actor. Armor's printed 'make yourself immune ...' and the potions' printed 'When you drink ... you ...' (or their equivalent drinking sentences) are the governing source. These actor/delivery meanings correctly belong to the DM and must remain untyped; the missing adjudication spans are the defect.

Concrete output: records.json:89543 has Armor activate-immunity with action only; its executionReadiness contains only three engine-pending economy/effect clauses, ZERO adjudicated clauses. Potion of Climbing record begins :117430 and has a retained drink operation but ZERO adjudicated clauses carrying 'When you drink this potion, you gain a climbing speed ...'. Same zero-clause result independently enumerated for the entire 17-member cohort. The comments at Corpus.ts:201-203/:629 dismiss literal 'self' as an unprinted token and therefore remove it before triage sees it; that lexical observation does not disposition the printed 'you/yourself' rule.

Mechanism/scenario: applyFaithfulMagicItemOperations runs before applyMagicItemTriage. The patch's requirement/target:null fields are gone by triageActivations, which creates spans only for fields still in the draft or an explicit OPERATION_SPANS entry. applyFaithfulMagicItemOperations.ts:1116-1127 requires a clause for removed COSTS only, not removed target/requirement fields. These early-null rows have no explicit replacement anchors, so the intended source -> adjudication-clause path disappears. A consumer enumerating the record's intentional adjudication clauses receives no governing actor/delivery sentence for these removed activation targets. Source prose still exists in description, and current execution remains blocked; no loss of the whole description or newly enabled mutation is alleged. The issue is the explicitly required positive disposition/evidence boundary.

Sibling/state analysis: audited every early-null operation patch and every old source-verbatim activation fragment, plus all current clauses and previous-head spans. Elemental Gem break, Feather Token kinds, Hammer hurl and Sword of Wounding null-target rows carry governing sentences through other clauses and are positive controls. Purely invented Dagger 'dagger is coated' prerequisite has no legitimate activation permission to restore. All 338 present adjudicated spans are verbatim; all previous-head spans survive. Neither fact detects the missing replacement class. magicItemTriage.test.ts:181-224 checks only entries already in WITHHELD/GRANT_SPANS/OPERATION_SPANS, and the actor-null rows are outside those tables. General source-agreement test's rejection of 'self' inside 'yourself' correctly rejects a literal typed span but never asserts the required replacement. Membership/count pins and passing tests are therefore not complete evidence for this invariant.

Closure: for the source-governed activation fields removed before triage, carry the full printed governing actor/delivery sentence in an adjudicated-by-design clause. Preserve the absence of typed targets/conditions and the existing operation/economy/effect identities; do not restore inferred 'self', invent a new target contract, or demand typing an adjudicated category. Sweep early deletions across both tables and make required disposition survive compiler ordering. Generalized permanent evidence: each source-governed early-null replacement carries its governing sentence, with these actual missing cases and already-covered null-field controls. Cheap lexical span membership plus independently selected governing passages is proportionate; no new proof platform or every malformed-input permutation.
